# API Conventions & Standards

Standardized conventions for REST API design. Use as the **single source of truth** for all API specs generated by this skill.

---

## URL Structure

```
/api/v{version}/{resource}[/{id}][/{sub-resource}]
```

**Rules:**

- Resources are **plural nouns**: `/users`, `/orders`, `/products`
- Use **kebab-case** for multi-word: `/user-profiles`, `/order-items`
- Nested resources max **1 level deep**: `/users/{id}/orders` (OK), `/users/{id}/orders/{orderId}/items` (avoid — use `/order-items?user_id={id}&order_id={orderId}`)
- Use path parameters for **entity identification**, query parameters for **filtering/sorting/pagination`

## HTTP Methods

| Method | Usage | Idempotent | Request Body |
|--------|-------|------------|--------------|
| GET | Read / list | Yes | No |
| POST | Create new resource | No | Yes |
| PUT | Full replacement of resource | Yes | Yes |
| PATCH | Partial update | No | Yes |
| DELETE | Remove resource | Yes | No |

**Special cases:**
- POST for **complex search/filter** when query params are too long or contain nested objects
- POST for **actions/operations**: `/users/{id}/activate`, `/orders/{id}/cancel`

## Versioning

```
/api/v1/users
/api/v2/users
```

- Default: **URI path versioning** (`/v1/`, `/v2/`)
- Version bump only on **breaking changes** (field removal, type change, endpoint removal)
- Additive changes (new fields, new endpoints) do **not** require version bump
- Document deprecated endpoints with sunset date: `Deprecation: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 00:00:00 GMT`

## Pagination

All list endpoints **must** support pagination.

**Query parameters:**

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `page` | integer | 1 | Page number (1-based) |
| `perPage` | integer | 20 | Items per page (max: 100) |
| `sortBy` | string | `created_at` | Field to sort by |
| `sortOrder` | string | `desc` | `asc` or `desc` |

**Response envelope:**

```json
{
  "data": [
    { "id": "uuid", "email": "user@example.com" }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page": 1,
    "perPage": 20,
    "totalPages": 5,
    "totalItems": 95,
    "hasNextPage": true,
    "hasPrevPage": false
  }
}
```

**Cursor-based** (optional, for large datasets / real-time feeds):

```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": {
    "cursor": "eyJpZCI6IjEyMyJ9",
    "hasMore": true
  }
}
```

## Filtering

**Simple filters** — query params:

```
GET /users?role=admin&status=active
GET /orders?created_after=2026-01-01&created_before=2026-03-31
```

**Advanced filters** — bracket notation or POST body:

```
GET /users?filter[role]=admin&filter[status]=active
GET /orders?filter[total_gte]=100000&filter[status]=pending
```

**Filter operators** (for numeric/date fields):

| Suffix | Meaning | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `_gte` | Greater than or equal | `filter[price_gte]=10000` |
| `_lte` | Less than or equal | `filter[price_lte]=50000` |
| `_gt` | Greater than | `filter[created_gt]=2026-01-01` |
| `_lt` | Less than | `filter[created_lt]=2026-12-31` |
| `_ne` | Not equal | `filter[status_ne]=deleted` |
| `_in` | In list | `filter[status_in]=active,pending` |
| `_like` | Pattern match | `filter[name_like]=john` |

## Search

Full-text search via dedicated parameter:

```
GET /users?search=john+doe
```

- Searches across designated searchable fields (documented per endpoint)
- Returns results ranked by relevance (if supported)
- Can combine with filters: `?search=john&role=admin`

## Response Envelope

### Single item

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "full_name": "John Doe"
  }
}
```

### List

```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "perPage": 20, "totalPages": 5, "totalItems": 95 }
}
```

### Action / empty response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "success": true,
    "message": "User activated successfully"
  }
}
```

## Authentication Headers

```
Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
```

**Rate limit headers** (response):

```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 87
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1713168000
```

## Field Naming

| Layer | Convention | Example |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| JSON (request/response) | **camelCase** | `fullName`, `createdAt`, `isActive` |
| Database columns | **snake_case** | `full_name`, `created_at`, `is_active` |
| URL path | **kebab-case** | `/user-profiles` |
| Query params | **camelCase** | `?sortBy=createdAt` |

The API layer maps between camelCase (JSON) and snake_case (DB).

## Soft Delete

When `deleted_at` column exists:

- DELETE endpoint sets `deleted_at = NOW()` (does not physically remove)
- All list endpoints **by default exclude** soft-deleted records (`WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`)
- Optional query param `?include_deleted=true` for admin endpoints
- Response for deleted resource: `404 Not Found` (same as non-existent)

## Common Endpoint Patterns

| Operation | Method | Path | Response |
|-----------|--------|------|----------|
| List | GET | `/users` | 200 + paginated list |
| Get by ID | GET | `/users/{id}` | 200 + single item |
| Create | POST | `/users` | 201 + created item |
| Full update | PUT | `/users/{id}` | 200 + updated item |
| Partial update | PATCH | `/users/{id}` | 200 + updated item |
| Delete | DELETE | `/users/{id}` | 200 or 204 |
| Count | GET | `/users/count` | 200 + `{ data: { count: N } }` |
| Export | GET | `/users/export?format=xlsx` | 200 + file stream |
| Bulk action | POST | `/users/bulk-activate` | 200 + result summary |
| Action | POST | `/users/{id}/activate` | 200 + updated item |

## Timestamps

All timestamps in **ISO 8601** format:

```json
{
  "createdAt": "2026-04-15T08:30:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-04-15T10:45:00Z"
}
```

- Store in UTC
- Client handles timezone conversion
- Include timezone offset when client sends datetime: `2026-04-15T15:30:00+07:00`

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] All list endpoints have pagination with `meta` object
- [ ] URL uses plural resource names in kebab-case
- [ ] JSON fields in camelCase, DB columns in snake_case
- [ ] Version prefix in URL (`/api/v1/...`)
- [ ] Error responses follow error catalog standard (see `references/error_catalog.md`)
- [ ] Auth required for all endpoints except registration and login
- [ ] Soft delete respected in all list queries
- [ ] Timestamps in ISO 8601 UTC
